issue.body: Fixes race condition in ILM Shrink action (#109206). Ensures ILM execution state is copied before execution, improving stability.

body: After some internal discussions, we came up with the solution to (re)add an index setting that tells ILM to skip the index. This setting should be added in the `ResizeRequest` and removed when we add the execution state to the shrunken index (i.e. after the resize request/shard allocation has completed). See https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/34823 for inspiration - that PR removed such a setting due to a lack of use cases.

issue.body:
We add the skip setting to prevent ILM from processing the shrunken index before the execution state has been copied - which could happen if the shards of the shrunken index take a long time to allocate.

Resolves #109206
